messages:
mira: Vendor requested a retest after our remediation sprint. Need ephemeral RBAC, limited KMS metadata access, and an evidence handoff. Can we do a 2h window next Tue?
jon: Tue OK for infra. Need exact services in-scope to pre-create roles.
mira: In-scope: api-gateway, inference-serving, console-auth. Exclude analytics. Proposed 14:00-16:00 UTC.
ana: SRE: we can create an ephemeral assume-role with 2h TTL + 15m buffer. Will that satisfy vendor?
sam: Product: vendor only needs to verify wrapped artifacts; no Decrypt. Provide KMS metadata & wrapped-key checksum via proxy.
jon: We'll stand up a KMS proxy endpoint that returns key id, algorithm, and wrapped-key checksum. Enforce mTLS and IP allowlist.
mira: Evidence: presigned S3 links (1h TTL) + sha256 checksums. Vendor will upload artifacts and include a manifest.
ana: I'll add a small upload helper and manifest template. Example manifest snippet:
```
{
  "artifact": "inference-stacktrace.tgz",
  "sha256": "<hex>",
  "s3_url": "https://...",
  "signed_by": "mira",
  "timestamp": "2026-04-02T14:05:00Z"
}
```
jon: Audit: flip on sampling flag pen_test=true for full traces for uploads. Route those events to evidence-readonly stream with 180d retention.
sec-bot: checklist: 1) Ephemeral role (TTL 02:15) - pending; 2) KMS proxy - in progress; 3) Presigned links TTL 01:00 - pending; 4) pen_test sampling - pending; 5) manifest template - created.
sam: Remediation tracking: create Jira board PT-RETEST-2026-04-02. Tickets require fields: vuln_id, repro_steps, verify_command, manifest_link. Verification should be automated where possible.
mira: Ops constraint: throttle inference-serving tests to 50 rps, canary subnet. Abort if latency > 20% of baseline.
jon: Add fallback: if dedicated capacity exhausted, route to staging-compatible model variant. Document in runbook.
mira: Legal wants an NDA addendum referencing ephemeral role window. Sam will attach to Jira ticket.
sec-bot: note: alerts suppressed for pen_test=true unless severity >= high.
mira: Next steps: ana to create role + presigned helper, jon to finish KMS proxy, sam to create Jira + NDA, I'll draft runbook and manifest. Ping when done. :thumbsup:
